summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for NCP1117ST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3, fixed-ldo): evaluated 37 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 5 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 3 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (65 µA vs 6000 µA); Lower dropout (800 mV vs 1070 mV)
Advanced Monolithic Systems multi-source option in SOT-223-3
candidates.key_tradeoff: Verify θJA (90 °C/W) and latest Advanced Monolithic Systems datasheet revision

candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (4000 µA vs 6000 µA); Ceramic MLCC stable (no tantalum ESR floor)
Texas Instruments multi-source option in SOT-223-3

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (60 µA vs 6000 µA); Lower dropout (340 mV vs 1070 mV)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Vin,max (6 V vs 15 V)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Texas Instruments multi-source option in SOT-223-3
candidates.key_tradeoff: Not drop-in: fixed LDO output voltage rail mismatch (3.3 V vs 5 V); Lower Iout (800 mA vs 1000 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (2000 µA vs 6000 µA); Higher Vin,max (26 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Iout (400 mA vs 1000 mA)

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.033–2.2 Ω (p.9)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 4.7 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (125 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (15 V rec / 20 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
